project_name.justification: The text states that Volt Carbon Technologies entered into an option agreement for "EPR's Tetepisca Graphite Project, located in Northern Quebec".

company_name.justification: The buyer is identified in the press release: "Volt Carbon Technologies Inc. (TSXV: VCT) ... is pleased to announce that it has entered into an option agreement with E-Power Resources Inc. (CSE: EPR)".

ceo_buyer.justification: The press releases are signed on behalf of the buyer by "V-Bond Lee, P. Eng. CEO, President, Chairman of the Board and Director".

interest_acquired_percent.justification: The agreement grants Volt an option to acquire a specific interest: "grant Volt an option to acquire an undivided five percent (5%) interest in the Property".

primary_commodity.justification: The project is explicitly named as a graphite project: "EPR's Tetepisca Graphite Project".

verified_article_link.justification: The article titled "Volt Carbon Technologies Announces Regulatory Approval of Arm's Length Option Agreement with E-Power Resources" directly concerns the transaction for the Tetepisca project.

currency.justification: The consideration is listed in '$' and the involved companies are listed on Canadian exchanges (TSXV, CSE) for a project located in Quebec, Canada, implying the Canadian Dollar (CAD).

cash_payments_raw.justification: A conditional cash payment is required to exercise the option: "Should Volt choose to exercise the Property Option, in addition to the Exploration Expenditures, Volt will be required to make a cash payment of $1,500,000 to EPR."

share_payments_raw.justification: The buyer, Volt Carbon Technologies, is not issuing its own shares as payment. The seller, E-Power Resources Inc., is issuing shares to Volt.
